content.doc_md:
## Tutorials

The POWER() function returns the value of a number raised to the power of 
another number.

Note:This function is equal to thePOW()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT POWER(4, 2);

---

POWER(
x, y
)

---

SELECT POWER(8, 3);
```

## Tutorials

The RADIANS() function converts a degree value into radians.

Note:See also theDEGREES()andPI()functions.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT RADIANS(180);

---

RADIANS(
number
)

---

SELECT RADIANS(-45);
```

## Tutorials

The RAND() function returns a random number between 0 (inclusive) and 1 
(exclusive).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT RAND();

---

RAND(
seed
)

---

SELECT RAND(6);

---

SELECT RAND()*(10-5)+5;

---

SELECT FLOOR(RAND()*(10-5+1)+5);
```

## Tutorials

The ROUND() function rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places.

Note:See also theFLOOR(),CEIL(),CEILING(), andTRUNCATE()functions.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ROUND(135.375, 2);

---

ROUND(
number
,
decimals
)

---

SELECT ROUND(345.156, 
  0);

---

SELECT ProductName, Price, ROUND(Price, 1) AS RoundedPrice
FROM Products;
```
